summary: war-room-motion check (#599): installed ffmpeg, which exposed a real failure. Two renders of the identical frozen room differ by one level in 7-23 of 921,600 pixels on this Windows GPU (nondeterminism, also at the same phase), so the byte-identical freeze assertion failed. Freeze/motion/resume now compare bytes differing by more than one level; frozen must show zero, real motion must show some. No game or visual change.
